content.title: REITs playbook: Investors must remain 'selective' post–rate cuts
content.description:
The Federal Reserve cut interest rates by 25 basis points at its September meeting on Wednesday — the first rate cut in 2025. The US central bank currently forecasts two more rate cuts in 2025.

Mizuho Americas senior REIT and homebuilders analyst Haendel St. Juste joins Asking for a Trend with Josh Lipton to discuss how to play the real estate investment trusts (REITs) sector amid the backdrop of rate cuts.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.

content.title: Camden Property price target lowered to $123 from $131 at Truist
content.summary: Truist lowered the firm’s price target on Camden Property (CPT) to $123 from $131 but keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The REIT is the second-best performer in the firm’s apartment coverage universe year-to-date and remains its “highest conviction Buy in the group”, the analyst tells investors in a research note. Truist adds however that it is slightly lowering its FFO estimates and price target with national job growth slowing a little faster than previously expected. Published first on TheFly
